findings.F1: The book's Calmar of 0.33 comes from a deepest fall of -58.5 % over 82 days across windows w16–w17, which is deeper than the coins' own chained fall of -43.9 % over the same days; the book's chain lost -56.9 %.
findings.F2: The book is mostly a leveraged long on the coins rather than a timing book: it is long on 75 % of bars with a mean allocation of 0.70, and of its mean gain of 1.82 bp per bar, 1.54 bp is the coins' own drift and only 0.27 bp is timing.
findings.F3: The idea's edge is negligible. Per case, the unusual move is +0.02 % over 18 bars, 0.003 of the usual 8.17 % move and 0.1 times the 0.19 % trade cost, over 4334 cases (t 0.14). So the book's falls are the market's falls, which the signal does not avoid.

ideas.idea: When a coin has just fallen in an unbroken streak of four-hour periods, and the volume across the streak has been declining, it rises over the next three days, only while the coin's 30-day return is positive; the larger that 30-day rise, the larger the rebound.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys fading-volume down-streaks only as dips inside a strong 30-day uptrend, and stays out of those inside a decline, which keep falling.
ideas.name: down-streak rebound in uptrends

ideas.idea: When a coin has just fallen in an unbroken streak of four-hour periods, and the volume across the streak has been declining, it rises over the next three days, only while the coin stays close to its 60-day high; the closer to that high, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys short-lived dips near recent highs and refuses down-streaks deep in a correction, where the book's falls build.
ideas.name: dip rebound near highs

ideas.idea: When a coin has just fallen in an unbroken streak of four-hour periods, and the volume across the streak has been declining, it rises over the next three days, only while its 5-day volatility exceeds its 30-day volatility; the larger that ratio, the larger the rise.
ideas.consequence: A trader buys fading-volume down-streaks in expanding-volatility moments, and refuses them in quiet markets, where they drift on down.
ideas.name: rebound under volatility expansion
